resourceName: Taikefeng Composting Project in Gaomi City
description:
The project involves installing 3 composting plants respectivelly in Xianjia Industrial Park (Plant 1), Shuangmiao village of Mishui Sub-district (Plant 2) and zhangxinzhuang village of Liquan Sub-district (Plant 3), Gaomi city, Weifang city, Shandong Province in order to treat the manure from the chicken farms and Biomass waste residue such as Cassava residue and chaff in Gaomi city. The purpose of the project activity is to avoid methane emissions through controlled aerobic treatment by composting of manure and biomass residue.
In absence of the project, all manure waste produced was left to decay in uncovered anaerobic lagoons, which is the most economic, viable and reasonable for livestock farm owners and the biomass waste residue had been left to decay anaerobically in a solid waste disposal site (SWDS).
This project started operation on 12/07/2020 totally (Plant 1 starts commission on 06/07/2020. Plant 2 starts commissioning on 10/07/2020, Plant 3 starts commissioning on 12/07/2020). 
The proposed project includes 3 new building composting plants which designed to treat organic wastes to produce organic fertilizer. The proposed project comprises of fermentation system and fertilizer production system, etc. It is estimated that approximately 28,800tons of manure and 9,504tons of biomass waste residue can treat annually in each composting plant, therefore total 114,912 tons of waste can be composted aerobically for this project. The final compost obtained will be sold to local businesses.
The project activity will reduce of GHG in the atmosphere through avoiding methane emissions from controlled aerobic treatment by composting of manure and biomass residue. It is estimated that 50,805 tCO2e emission reductions will be generated annually and total emission reductions are 508,054 tCO2e in the 10 years’ fixing crediting period.
